map.估计总体均值所需的最小样本量由允许误差 e、总体标准差 σ 与置信水平对应的 z: The minimum sample size needed to estimate a population mean follows from the tolerated error e, the population standard deviation σ and the z value for the chosen confidence level: a smaller error, a larger σ or a higher confidence level all increase the required size. The z value can be entered by hand (95% corresponds to 1.96 and 99% to 2.576) and the result is rounded up.
map.σ 未知可用历史估计。: If σ is unknown, use a historical estimate.
map.e 越小样本量越大。: A smaller e means a larger sample size.

map.n=(z·σ/e)²，给定精度 e 与置信。: n=(z·σ/e)² for a given precision e and confidence level.
map.z=1.96、σ=10、e=2：n=(1.96×10/2)²=(9.8)²=96: z=1.96, σ=10, e=2: n=(1.96×10/2)²=(9.8)²=96.04→97, so at least 97 observations are required.
